description: List listed companies (stocks) matching filters such as country, sector, industry group, industry, exchange and market cap tier, or matching a free-text query on symbol or name. Every filter accepts one value or several comma-separated values. Use show_options('equities', '<field>') to see valid filter values. Returns categorisation (sector, industry, country, exchange, market cap tier), not prices.

country.description: Country of the company's headquarters, e.g. 'United States' or 'Netherlands'. This is not where it trades: ASML (Netherlands) is also listed in New York and Frankfurt. To find the listings in a country, filter on exchange or currency. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
country.title: Country

currency.description: Trading currency as an ISO code, e.g. 'USD' or 'EUR'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
currency.title: Currency

exchange.description: Exchange code, e.g. 'NMS' (NASDAQ Global Select), 'NYQ' (NYSE), 'PNK' (OTC Markets) or 'AMS' (Euronext Amsterdam). Use it to find an instrument's listings on certain exchanges, e.g. query='ASML' with exchange='NMS,NYQ,PNK' for its US listings. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
exchange.title: Exchange

include_delisted.description: Include delisted entries (excluded by default). Adds a `delisted` column.
include_delisted.title: Include Delisted

include_summary.description: Add the business/fund description (truncated to 300 characters). Off by default to keep responses small.
include_summary.title: Include Summary

industry.description: Industry, e.g. 'Biotechnology', 'Banks' or 'Hospitality & Leisure'. Use show_options to find the exact names. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
industry.title: Industry

industry_group.description: Industry group, e.g. 'Semiconductors' or 'Banking'. Use show_options to find the exact names. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
industry_group.title: Industry Group

market.description: Full market name, e.g. 'NASDAQ Global Select' or 'Euronext Amsterdam'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
market.title: Market

market_cap.description: Market cap tier: 'Mega Cap' (>= $200B), 'Large Cap' (>= $10B), 'Mid Cap' (>= $2B), 'Small Cap' (>= $300M), 'Micro Cap' (>= $50M) or 'Nano Cap'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
market_cap.title: Market Cap

mic.description: ISO 10383 market identifier code, e.g. 'XNAS', 'XNYS' or 'XAMS'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
mic.title: Mic

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (see the `_notes` hint in the response).
offset.title: Offset

only_primary_listing.description: Only primary listings: per instrument its listing on the main exchange of its home market (ASML.AS for ASML), or without one its listing on the largest main exchange abroad. Leaves out cross-listings, over-the-counter lines and depositary receipts.
only_primary_listing.title: Only Primary Listing

query.description: Optional free-text search on symbol and name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'apple' or 'AAPL'); an ISIN also matches where available. Best matches come first.
query.title: Query

sector.description: Sector, e.g. 'Information Technology', 'Health Care' or 'Financials'. Several values: comma-separated (e.g. 'A, B') or a list. Case-insensitive.
sector.title: Sector

show_columns.description: Columns to return, comma-separated. Default: symbol, name, currency, sector, industry_group, industry, exchange, country, market_cap. Available: symbol, name, summary, currency, sector, industry_group, industry, exchange, mic, market, country, state, city, zipcode, website, market_cap, isin, cusip, figi, composite_figi, shareclass_figi, delisted.
show_columns.title: Show Columns

name: equities
